values.note: Reclamation: 'full service hook-ups for recreational vehicles by the day, week, or month'; amperage not stated. Reservoir-wide Reclamation counts 55 RV hookups (40 full service, 9 water and electric only, 6 winter service) across its campgrounds (2017 table).

hookups.source: https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/clarkcanyon/clark_canyon_recreation_brochure.pdf ('LEWIS & CLARK CAMPGROUND - The Lewis and Clark Campground / Marina Area offers full service hook-ups for recreational vehicles by the day, week, or month with a self pay fee station. A boat ramp and courtesy dock are available at no charge to the public.') + https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/ccrrec.html (RV Hookups 55 total, 40 full service), read 2026-10-22

note: Developed Bureau of Reclamation campground and marina area at Clark Canyon Reservoir on the Beaverhead River, ~20 mi S of Dillon off I-15. Lewis & Clark is the one hookup loop of the reservoir's campgrounds, paid at a self-pay station (~$30/night); vault toilets, drinking water, boat ramp and courtesy dock. The other Clark Canyon campgrounds are free and first-come, first-served. --Claude
summary: Reclamation's brochure confirms full-service RV hookups (water/sewer now verified; amperage not stated) by the day, week or month at a self-pay station, plus boat ramp and courtesy dock. Reclamation publishes no current fee, site count, season or toilet/water detail for this campground (its facilities table dates from 2017), so nothing else written. Note trimmed of the 'full RV hookups' restatement.
flags: Inherited booking looks wrong here: the federal row gives reservable on recreation.gov with a 180-day window, but Reclamation describes a self-pay fee station and recreation.gov's Clark Canyon Reservoir gateway (131) is not reservable and lists no Lewis & Clark campground. Probably first-come; nothing official says so outright.
Missing phone: Reclamation Clark Canyon Field Office (406) 683-6472 (also (406) 683-2307), https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/clarkcanyon/.
Fees: the note's ~$30/night has no official source (reviews only); Reclamation's 2017 facilities table says 'Campgrounds: no' fee, and the inherited senior/access discount is unconfirmed.
Name: Reclamation calls it 'Lewis & Clark Campground' (the 'Lewis and Clark Campground / Marina Area'); the entry's 'Clark Canyon Reservoir, Lewis & Clark Campground' is fine as a disambiguator.
Sizing unconfirmed by Reclamation; a 2022 review (Campendium) says the lower tier fits RVs up to ~22 ft and the upper tier 30-35 ft.
